correctness.rationale: The radial wedge formula is integrated analytically, transformed with theta_i=pi-2alpha_i and the sine-double-angle identity; the exact nonnegative two-product factorization yields the global sharp bound and equality classification. Radial vertex extension addresses all triangles, not only boundary-inscribed ones. The right-isosceles limit attains the closure value while failing the origin-interior condition. Direct derivative calculations give F''(pi/3)=0 and F'''(pi/3)=8, hence a sign-changing -8t^3 perturbation. Independent barycentric moment formula and standard-library tests corroborate all normalizations, not replace the infinite proof. Limits: exact q=4,d=2,3 vertices only.

The quantitative nonattainment and complete shape classification are a substantive small-complexity boundary phenomenon, not a mere generic negative check or arbitrary parameter slice.
